The '''Night Jaws''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] [[Priest/Legends|priest]] who was freed from imprisonment in [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A high-ranking member of his [[Species/Legends|species]] who had earned a name of his own, the Night Jaws led the Esh-kha worshippers in the [[Esh-kha sanctuary]], a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault in the [[Power Center cavern]] taken over by the Esh-kha during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Imperial forces who looted the sanctuary's symbol.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Night Jaws is the target of the final stage of "The Esh-kha Sanctuary," an Area mission for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
